newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Menem expects to bring patent plan to US - report.
newsitem.headline: Menem expects to bring patent plan to US - report.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem said in an interview published Tuesday that he expects to bring a proposal to resolve a sticky patents dispute to the United States next month.
"I expect to bring some type of positive response on patents to the United States," he told La Nacion.
Menem will travel to Washington early next month on an agenda expected to include a meeting with President Bill Clinton.
Patents has been one of the few points of contention in an otherwise strong relationship between Argentina and the United States in the past two years.
Washington says foreign pharmaceutical firms lose $500 million a year in Argentina to bootleggers, while Argentine drug firms have lobbied Congress successfully.

White House Senior Counselor Thomas McLarty, on a visit last week to Argentina, said the United States was "frankly disappointed" by a law passed this year which only phases in patent protection over five years.
